result:
I added comments, deleting, reporting and auto-hiding to the blog. `pnpm typecheck` passes. I didn't run the app or any tests, so none of the behaviour has been exercised yet.

- **Storage:** `db/schema.ts` has two new tables, `comments` and `comment_reports`. Reports are unique on (`comment_id`, `user_id`), so a repeat report is ignored. The migration was generated with `void db generate` and is in `db/migrations/`.
- **Commenting:** `POST /posts/:id?comment` is a new action in `pages/posts/[id].server.ts`. A guest is redirected to `/login`. A body that isn't 1–2000 characters fails with `errors.body`, the same way a bad post title does, and stores nothing. A valid comment redirects to the post.
- **Post page data:** The post page data gains `comments`, oldest first, with ISO `createdAt` and `author { id, name }`. A comment is left out once 3 different users have reported it, but it stays in the table. The page also gets `viewerId`.
- **Delete and report:**
  - `DELETE /comments/:id` redirects to the post for the comment's author or the post's author. Anyone else gets 403.
  - `POST /comments/:id/report` always returns 204.
  - Both redirect a guest to `/login`.
  - They live in `routes/comments/[id].ts` and `routes/comments/[id]/report.ts`, backed by a new `lib/comments.ts`.
- **Post deletion:** Deleting a post now also deletes its comments and their reports. The comment tables also carry cascade foreign keys.
- **UI:** `pages/posts/[id].tsx` lists the comments with author and time, shows a comment box when signed in, and offers Delete and Report where allowed.

A comment body is not trimmed, so a whitespace-only comment counts as valid. Say if you want it trimmed.
